label: Human Grill、blocked/recovery与重新preflight
notes: 协议设计已冻结，进入TDD实现。已完成第一条纵切：HumanGrill结构化对象、HumanGrillDecision、内存CAS coordinator、SQLite append-only StateStore CAS持久化；覆盖accepted/duplicate/conflict/stale-decision、跨连接并发winner收敛和side_effects_executed=false。已完成第二条recovery纵切：独立RecoveryDecision、adopt/reconcile/compensate/abandon单winner CAS、parent_execution_id与uncertainty Evidence绑定、SQLite append-only recovery decision persistence、RecoveryPlanRevisionRecord envelope（含event_id、parent plan/execution、decision/evidence和digest绑定）、ArtifactStore/StateStore双层创建持久化、re-preflight readiness gate、claimRecoveryTask fail-closed适配器和StateStore parent execution.started事实校验；覆盖accepted/duplicate/conflict/stale-decision、跨连接并发、parent binding、旧revision阻断、Artifact绑定、Plan/Grant digest匹配、不同重试时间的幂等、父Execution缺失/终止阻断、完整正向委托和side_effects_executed=false。下一步先解决通用claim的task identity是否需要包含Plan/Execution scope，再继续 recovery claim 的重复/并发验证。MVP范围：Human Grill、Human Decision、Plan revision、CAS幂等/冲突/stale、blocked/recovery、Provider outcome uncertainty、re-preflight唯一放行、HumanSigner验证与Key撤销检查、内存/SQLite StateStore与ArtifactStore、模拟Provider、并发/离线stale/跨设备通知协议测试。暂不实现完整Web UI、真实多平台签名provider全适配、生产Provider副作用、P2P传输和复杂同步冲突自动合并。已完成通用claim identity纵切：claim scope固定包含network_id、event_id、plan_id、plan_revision、execution_id、task_id、node_id；StateStore聚合查询不再只按task_id，旧Execution/Plan不会污染新Recovery claim；同scope retry返回duplicate，不同scope可独立claimed，并发scope只有一个winner。已构建并通过18项Human Grill/recovery/runtime claim聚焦测试，覆盖隔离、CAS并发、正向recovery委托和side_effects_executed=false。已完成Provider outcome协议纵切：新增闭合provider-neutral ProviderOutcome，固定confirmed-success、confirmed-failure-no-side-effect、partial-success、outcome-uncertain四类结果；各类必须携带对应receipt、无副作用证明、部分资源观察或不确定冻结scope与有界reconciliation_budget；结果绑定network/event/plan/revision/execution/task/provider_request/resource scope并生成canonical digest；跨scope绑定不匹配fail-closed。3项ProviderOutcome测试通过，模拟结果与真实Provider边界保持分离。已完成Provider outcome事实记录纵切：recordProviderOutcome将合法结果追加为provider.outcome.recorded StateStore事实；相同provider_request_id与相同outcome_digest幂等duplicate，不同结果conflict，非法结果blocked；事实记录不推进Task、不调用Provider且自身side_effects_executed=false。Provider协议与事实层共5项测试通过。已完成isolated SimulatedProvider fixture纵切：通过同一provider-neutral adapter边界生成四类ProviderOutcome；fixture使用独立namespace和可重置虚拟资源状态，结果显式标记provider_kind=simulated、fixture_state_digest、virtual_side_effects和real_provider_calls=0；同provider_request_id重试复用结果，request digest冲突fail-closed，不产生真实外部调用。新增7项Provider协议/事实/fixture测试。已完成Provider outcome到生命周期映射纵切：confirmed-success仅进入verification-required；confirmed-failure-no-side-effect进入recovery-required；partial-success冻结资源并进入needs-human-grill；outcome-uncertain冻结资源并保持blocked；非法outcome进入blocked-input。映射纯协议、task_completed恒为false、side_effects_executed恒为false，不自动创建RecoveryDecision或补偿动作；相关回归9项通过。已完成独立Provider outcome verification纵切：只有confirmed-success可创建VerificationRecord；verifier_id必须不同于Provider，记录绑定outcome_digest、Plan/Execution/Task scope、完整验收条件、满足/失败条件和evidence_digest；结果为passed或failed，均要求Review Handoff，provider_retry_allowed=false、side_effects_executed=false；非法或非success outcome一律blocked。相关回归11项通过。已完成Verification事实持久化纵切：recordProviderOutcomeVerification追加verification.passed或verification.failed；相同verification_digest返回duplicate，同一outcome scope不同验证结果返回conflict；非法记录blocked；不追加task.completed、不自动推进Review Handoff，记录接口自身side_effects_executed=false。相关回归13项通过。已完成Review Handoff纯协议纵切：仅verification.passed、dependencies_closed=true且remaining_risks为空时accepted；verification.failed、未闭合依赖或剩余风险返回blocked并保留reason；记录绑定outcome/verification/Plan/Execution/Task scope、外部资源最后已知状态和责任主体；event_completed/task_completed/side_effects_executed均为false。相关回归15项通过。
